tools.name: sea_level
tools.description: Projected sea-level rise at Singapore for a year and an emissions scenario (CCRS V3 2024, Ng et al. 2025, IPCC AR6), in metres above today's high-tide level.

tools.name: when_does_it_flood
tools.description: In which year each scenario reaches a given sea-level rise (metres above today's high tide), or "beyond 2150".

tools.name: check_address
tools.description: For a Singapore postal code or place name: the sea-level rise at which it first connects to the sea, and roughly when each scenario gets there.

tools.name: flood_impact
tools.description: Island-wide impact at a sea-level rise (or a year and scenario): share of Singapore's land flooded, buildings reached, residents living in flooded areas.

tools.name: area_impact
tools.description: Residents living in flooded parts of one planning area (e.g. Kallang, Punggol) at a sea-level rise or a year and scenario, and the first rise at which the area is reached.

tools.name: most_affected_areas
tools.description: The planning areas with the most residents in flooded areas at a sea-level rise (or a year and scenario).

tools.name: places_underwater
tools.description: Named public places (hawker centres, schools, places of worship) reached by the sea at a rise, optionally of one kind or in one planning area.

tools.name: list_areas
tools.description: The 55 URA planning areas the impact tools accept, with their resident populations.

tools.name: map_link
tools.description: A link that opens the Rising Shores map with the sea raised to a given rise (or a year and scenario).

tools.name: sources_and_method
tools.description: What the numbers are made from, their licences, and their limits. Read this before quoting any figure.
